exposure: Type of caesarean delivery (planned vs. emergency)
cohort: 4498 women who underwent planned or emergency caesarean delivery at one of 42 hospitals in Norway between January 1, 2008, and December 31, 2010
finding: Hospitals with guidelines recommending antibiotic prophylaxis for all caesarean deliveries had higher antibiotic provision rates and lower rates of superficial surgical-site infections after planned caesarean deliveries.
